programs.title: A Wild Year on Earth S1E5 -September-October
programs.desc: Travel around the world to see another seasonal change unfold. The Northern Hemisphere moves into autumn, while Australia witnesses a rebirth of life, and mating humpbacks fill the warming tropical seas of Tonga.

director: Karina Holden: Executive Producer, Daniella Ortega: Series Producer

programs.title: A Wild Year on Earth S1E6 -November-December
programs.desc: Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexico’s forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter.

director: Karina Holden: Executive Producer, Daniella Ortega: Series Producer

programs.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programs.desc: Unmask the eerie beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death. Swim with hungry crocodiles, see deer gamble with their lives for food, and watch carnivorous plants snap up prey.

director: Andrew Zikking: Executive Producer, Laura Coates: Series Producer

programs.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programs.desc: Tag along as Dr. Amanda rescues a blind pet baboon, and watch Dr. Charlotte’s tricky surgery on a pangolin whose leg must be amputated after a run-in with poachers. Later, chase a rhino, two young baboons gone AWOL, and a fiesty monitor lizard.

programs.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programs.desc: Face a tough decision when Esti’s leg infection puts the brakes on this young duiker’s release. Then track and collar a young lion with Dr. Amanda; check on an ailing bush baby; and greet the noisy new addition to the center, a grumpy grey parrot.

programs.title: Battle of the Alphas
programs.desc: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange - from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur moms that go into battle with baby on board.

director: Karen McCairley: Series Producer, Elliot Halpern and Elizabeth Trojian: Producers

programs.title: Wild Pacific Rescue
programs.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programs.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West
programs.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

director: Nick Robinson: Director, Mark Coles Smith: Narrator

programs.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West
programs.desc: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales.

director: Nick Robinson: Director, Mark Coles Smith: Narrator

programs.title: Africa's Hunters
programs.desc: Meet a close-knit family of wild dogs who work together to raise pups and hunt enough food to feed the whole pack. While their well-coordinated hunts are successful, the wet season brings challenges when some of the team strikes out on their own.
